name: post-task-skill-miner
summary: 复盘已完成的长任务，判断其中哪些经验值得沉淀为知识卡片、项目级 Skill、Loop 资产或团队共享 Skill。内置 6 信号 Loop 评分模型和字段映射 Rubric（合并自 session-to-loop）。
runtime_requirements: Use this skill after the task is materially complete so the retrospective is based on real outcomes instead of unfinished exploration.
post_install_hints: When this skill recommends creating or updating a reusable skill, continue with `skill-creator` or the local team-ai-kit create/submit workflow.
